data.long_description:
Discover serene living in this beautifully upgraded 3-bedroom villa located in the sought-after Springs 5 community. Featuring a Type 3E layout, this corner-unit villa boasts a spacious and functional design perfect for families seeking comfort, privacy, and picturesque views.

Key Features:-

Type 3E (Corner Unit)
3 Bedrooms + Study Room
Large Plot Size
Fully Upgraded Throughout
Renovated Bathrooms & Modern Flooring
Unfurnished – Add Your Personal Touch
Landscaped Private Garden
Covered Parking
Bright & Spacious Layout
Close to Schools, Parks & Community Amenities
Located in a Gated Community with 24/7 Security.

Nestled in the tranquil surroundings of The Springs, this villa offers peaceful lakefront living while remaining just minutes away from city conveniences. Ideal for families, the community features walking trails, pools, parks, and access to top schools.
